people.name: Cush
people.line: Ancient region in Africa; associated with Egypt and Babylon

people.name: Egypt
people.line: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus

translations.web: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
translations.bsb: Those who made Cush their hope and Egypt their boast will be dismayed and ashamed.
translations.kjv: And they shall be afraid and ashamed of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
translations.asv: And they shall be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
